title: 第25章 客户的优先级第26章 上善若水二合一
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第25章客户的优先级（..）“毕竟他经历了那么多事情嘛！”
提及这个曾经班上的话题人物，另一个女生也有些感触，“才大二啊，在我们大家都忙着考四六级的时候，他已经开始创业了，说明人家早就知道了这个社会看重的是什么……”
“哎，苗小玲，你当时是不是还喜欢周望来着？”
于沛沛这时坏笑道，“我记得你好像还写了封情书，只是没有送出去……”
“沛沛，别瞎说。”
方璐义正言辞的纠正了于沛沛，“苗小玲哪是当时喜欢，明明现在也还很喜欢！”
“啊，我跟你们拼了！”
脸颊通红的苗小玲扑了上去，几個女生顿时闹成了一团。
一旁的李晟摇摇头，骤然吃到这样的瓜也没什么惊讶，周望还没有颓废下去的时候，喜欢他的女生多了去了。
可惜狗哥就是太想证明自己了，或者，也是为了配得上丁一？
自认逻辑通畅的李晟不禁替周望感到不值，那么多妹妹等着你霍霍呢，结果就在一棵树上吊死了。
现在好了，西天极乐没去到，东土大唐也回不去了。
想到这，李晟居然还有些可怜起了周望，都想再发条信息安慰一下对方了！
“哈喽啊，同学们，好久不见！”
这时，被几个闺蜜缠着拍照的丁一终于脱开了身。
“小丁，生日快乐！”
“宝，你今天简直美炸了……”
看到丁一过来，众人也停止了打闹，女生一股脑的围了过去，只剩下李晟和另外一个男生坐在座位上。
他们自己和丁一不熟，但女朋友却都和丁一关系很好，属于是纯粹的陪伴人员，此时颇有些惺惺相惜的意味。
这时，丁一和一群女生亲热过后，她突然想起了什么，拍了拍光洁的额头，“对了，璐璐，沛沛，还有小媛，你们不是都想考本校的研吗，我介绍个人给伱们认识，也许对你们有帮助哦。”

“我自己是给不了你们什么建议啦，毕竟你们也知道我是保送的，嘻嘻……”
看着丁一得瑟的模样，几个女生又是一番笑闹，然后就看到丁一离开，回到了里厅，很快又挽着一个女生走了过来。
这明显是个姐姐，真正让一众女生眼睛泛光的是，这个姐姐不仅长得超级美，那股禁欲系的清冷气质，更是狠狠的戳中了她们的兴奋点。
“啊，杀我杀我！”
尤其是方璐这样的资深腐女，在心里不断的呐喊。
看到姜沫过来，刚刚在大堂里的李晟、于沛沛等人则是觉得有些惊奇，这不就是他们之前看到的那位姐姐吗？
“她是姜沫师姐，也是王红英教授的弟子哦，本科比我们大两届，她是凭自己的本事考上研究生的，你们有什么想问的都可以问她！”
丁一为众人介绍了一番，就让姜沫坐在了这里，她自己则有些奇怪的抬起头来。
人差不多齐了，接下来就准备上菜了，可路锦怎么去了那么久还没回来？
……
中餐厅的后厨门口，路锦正错愕的站在这里，在他面前的，是今天帮他安排包间的餐饮部副经理刘志明。
他们家是做照明工程的，平素里的接待应酬不少，因为经常都是在这家酒店的餐厅请客，路锦和这位刘经理也算得上很熟悉了。
之前正是因为从这位刘经理口中听说，他们餐饮部的定海神针，那位行政总厨罗文乐先生，这两天刚好会在酒店轮值，路锦这才动了心思。
通过父母的介绍，他认识丁一的时间其实已经不短了。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Financial Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 25 Customer Priorities (..) "After all, he has experienced so many things!"
Mentioning this once popular figure in the class, another girl also had some feelings, "He is only a sophomore. When we are all busy taking the CET-4 and CET-6 exams, he has already started a business, which shows that people have long known what this society values..."
"Hey, Miao Xiaoling, did you still like Zhou Wang at that time?"
Yu Peipei smiled evilly and said, "I remember you wrote a love letter, but you didn't send it out..."
"Peipei, don't talk nonsense."
Fang Lu corrected Yu Peipei righteously, "I didn't like Miao Xiaoling back then, but she still likes her now!"
"Ah, I will fight with you!"
Miao Xiaoling, whose cheeks were red, rushed forward, and the girls suddenly became a mess.
Li Sheng on the side shook his head. He was not surprised to suddenly eat such a melon. Before Zhou Wang became decadent, there were many girls who liked him.
It's a pity that Brother Gou wants to prove himself too much, or maybe it's also to be worthy of Ding Yi?
Li Sheng, who thought he was logically logical, couldn't help but feel unworthy of Zhou Wang. There were so many sisters waiting for you, but you ended up hanging from a tree.
It's better now. The bliss of the Western Heaven has not been reached, and the Tang Dynasty in the Eastern Land cannot return.
Thinking of this, Li Sheng actually felt a little pity for Zhou Wang, and wanted to send another message to comfort him!
"Hello, classmates, long time no see!"
At this time, Ding Yi, who was being pestered by several girlfriends to take pictures, finally got away.
"Xiao Ding, happy birthday!"
"Bao, you are so beautiful today..."
Seeing Ding coming over, everyone stopped fighting, and the girls gathered around, leaving only Li Sheng and another boy sitting in their seats.
They are not familiar with Ding Yi, but their girlfriends have a good relationship with Ding Yi. They are purely companions. At this time, there is quite a sense of sympathy for each other.
At this time, after Ding Yi had made out with a group of girls, she suddenly remembered something and patted her smooth forehead, "By the way, Lulu, Peipei, and Xiaoyuan, don't you all want to take the postgraduate entrance examination in this school? I will introduce someone to you, maybe it will be helpful to you."
"I can't give you any advice myself. After all, you know that I am recommended, hehe..."
Seeing Ding Yi's embarrassed look, several girls laughed again, and then saw Ding Yi leave and return to the back hall, and soon walked over with another girl on his arm.
This was obviously a sister. What really made the eyes of all the girls shine was that not only was this sister super beautiful, but her abstinent and cool temperament also hit their arousal point hard.
"Ah, kill me, kill me!"
Especially a senior fujoshi like Fang Lu kept shouting in her heart.
Seeing Jiang Mo coming over, Li Sheng, Yu Peipei and others who were in the lobby just now felt a little surprised. Isn't this the sister they saw before?
"She is Senior Sister Jiang Mo, and she is also a disciple of Professor Wang Hongying. Her undergraduate degree is two years older than ours. She was admitted to graduate school on her own merit. You can ask her anything you want to ask!"
Ding Yi introduced everyone and asked Jiang Mo to sit here. She herself raised her head strangely.
Everyone is almost here, and the food is ready to be served next, but why has Lu Jin been away for so long and not come back yet?
…
At the door of the back kitchen of the Chinese restaurant, Lu Jinzheng stood here in astonishment. In front of him was Liu Zhiming, the deputy manager of the catering department who helped him arrange a private room today.
Their family is engaged in lighting engineering, and they usually have a lot of reception and entertainment, because they often entertain guests in the restaurant of this hotel, so Lu Jin and Manager Liu are quite familiar with each other.
It was precisely because I heard from this manager Liu that the pinnacle of their catering department, the executive chef Mr. Luo Wenle, these twoTian happened to be on duty at the hotel, so Lu Jin got interested.
Through the introduction of his parents, he had known Ding Yi for a long time.
